provenance.quote: “Shall the Kechi Township, Kansas, be authorized to construct, equip and furnish a new township building for administrative use, equipment storage and maintenance, at an estimated total cost not to exceed $400,000; provided that all required funds for said project shall be derived solely from existing cash reserves currently held by the township and the proceeds from the sale of the existing township building, with zero dollars ($0.00) raised through the issuance of new bonds or any increase in the township's property tax levy, pursuant to the provisions of K.S.A. 80-104 et seq., as amended??”

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the township to build, furnish and equip an administrative, equipment-storage and maintenance building costing no more than $400,000. It would use existing cash reserves and proceeds from selling the current township building, with no new bonds or property-tax levy increase for this project.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the building project with these funding limits.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not authorize this building project.
